Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; IGNITE BUSINESSWOMEN INVESTMENT GROUP FOUNDATION. +]

[+(2) grants to community-based organizations specializing in women-focused entrepreneurship support. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for grants to Ignite Businesswomen Investment Group Foundation.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; IGNITE BUSINESSWOMEN INVESTMENT GROUP FOUNDATION.

(a) $1,400,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to Ignite Businesswomen Investment Group Foundation (IBWIG Foundation) to establish a women entrepreneurs access to capital and business development fund. Money appropriated under this paragraph may be used to provide working capital, capacity-building grants, and low-interest loans. IBWIG Foundation must prioritize women entrepreneurs in underserved and economically disadvantaged communities to conduct the activities under this paragraph. This is a onetime appropriation.

(b) $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to IBWIG Foundation to provide capacity building and business development support for women entrepreneurs. Money appropriated under this paragraph must be used to provide:

(1) business planning, leadership development, financial literacy, technology training, and marketing support; and

(2) grants to community-based organizations specializing in women-focused entrepreneurship support. This is a onetime appropriation.
